description: This file contains functions to calculate distances from a point to various graphical elements (rectanguloid, diamond, ellipse, line, free draw) in the Excalidraw project, utilizing imported math utilities and element-specific deconstruction functions.

methods.name: distanceToElement
methods.description: Calculates the distance from a point to a given Excalidraw element based on its type.

methods.name: distanceToRectanguloidElement
methods.description: Calculates the distance from a point to a rectangular-shaped element, considering rotation and roundness.

methods.name: distanceToDiamondElement
methods.description: Calculates the distance from a point to a diamond-shaped element, considering rotation and roundness.

methods.name: distanceToEllipseElement
methods.description: Calculates the distance from a point to an ellipse element, considering rotation.

methods.name: distanceToLinearOrFreeDraElement
methods.description: Calculates the minimum distance from a point to a linear or free draw element.
